pr_title: AJ-1077: add a waiting message while sync is happening

comments.body:
Please use the `CrmPopulateJobStatus` enum
```suggestion
        public async Task<CrmPopulateJobStatus> GetClientCrmPopulateJobStatus(string dbId, int clientId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

I think you picked the old version from resolving a merge conflict here. 
```suggestion
        Task UpdateClientCrmPopulateJobStatus(string dbId, int clientId, CrmPopulateJobStatus populateJobStatus, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
```
See below. If you map the result to enum in the query call helper then you don't have to map it here.
Can you make this a enum please. Refer to https://git.campmon.com/Freshview/createsend.com/blob/master/app/CampMon.Data.NetStandard/Crm/Model/CrmPopulateJobStatus.cs

You will need to check all three - `InProgress`, `Finalising`, `Failed`.

We won't be displaying a dedicated message for `Failed` (so display the same in-progress message) but it's important to not treat it as `Success`
Can you add a check so this is only called when the client has opted into the feature?
